name: Skytech Inc.
summary: Skytech Inc. engages in the semiconductor and related technology industries. The company provides thin film process, etching process, diffusion process, grinding process, measurement process, yellow light process, and automation equipment. The company's products include PVD and ALD machines; bonder and de-bonder machines; powder ALD machines; descum/plasma polish machines; single wafer load lock machines; PVD carbon machines; and customized parts and design products. It also offers semiconductor equipment parts repair services; and PVD, CVD, Etch, RTP, Wet, and metrology used equipment modification, refurbishment, installation, and relocation services.
